dataformat.name: rss
dataformat.title: RSS
dataformat.description: Transform from ROME SyndFeed Java Objects to XML and vice-versa
dataformat.label: dataformat,transformation

marshalIn.description: A ROME SyndFeed, such as the rss consumer gives, or the XML text of an RSS or Atom feed, which is parsed first

marshalOut.description: The RSS or Atom XML in the stream cache, or a byte array when stream caching is off

unmarshalOut.description: A ROME SyndFeed of the feed
